message:
feat(studio): five top-bar workspaces with tab ownership and frame presets

Replace named layouts with Design, Content, Media, Styles and Publish
workspaces: a top-bar tablist (mod+1..5), per-workspace frame presets,
tab ownership derived from each tab, workspace home tabs, the gear menu
in the command bar, and the target-state spec for the redesign.

author: Kevin Shenk <test@test.com>
message:
fix(studio): settle the quick-publish chevron test and print DOM nodes compactly on failure

Root cause: the chevron renders inside its own part="quick-slot" wrapper, so
`button.previousElementSibling` is always null. On CI (Bun 1.4.3) the failing
`toBe(strip())` printed both live kit elements' reactive graphs (2.8M lines) and
the job stalled until its cap; on Bun 1.4.2 it silently passed. The test now
asserts the slot follows the strip and holds only the chevron.

Guard: @jxsuite/ui/testing/inspect-dom defines Bun's inspect.custom hook on
happy-dom's Node.prototype, installed by a bunfig preload in studio and ui, so a
failing toBe between elements prints one line per node. A spawned fixture
proves it. Deep equality on live kit elements is still not covered.

CI: bun test runs under a 12-minute `timeout` with an ::error:: naming the
stalled workspace, a 14-minute step cap backs it, and setup-bun pins 1.4.3
exactly instead of the floating 1.4.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
